title: cynoglossum lithospermifolium subsp. cariense
intro: Cynoglossum lithospermifolium subsp. cariense, commonly known as Rockjunto, is a plant species in the borage family. It is a perennial herb native to the Iberian Peninsula. Rockjunto has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues and gastrointestinal problems. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
